- **Sense choices:**

  - "sound" in n04.1 is signal audible (rule r12.1).
  - "active" in n18.1 is power connected; in n13.1 it goes from power connected to registry current.
  - "clear" in n11.1 is contamination absent; in n01.1 it goes from contamination absent to optically transparent.
  - "open" in n21.1 is seal removed; in n03.1 it goes from seal removed to account enabled.
- **n18.2:** The three "would imply" conditionals also need unit0 to be optically transparent (rules r10.2–r10.4). So that step also takes the n01.1 result as a parent, even though the sentence appears earlier in the text.
- **Waivers:** I waived the sentences that only list declared rules, and n09.2 (checks left unassumed). I also waived rules r12.2, r08.2 and r04.2 and record r08.3, which the argument never uses.
